bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed"
img=create-videobot:menu-home-e9cc45d
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 61
docker image inspect "$img" >/dev/null || exit 62
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint grep "$img" -q 'A plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 63
test -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 64
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$n")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || exit 65
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true || exit 66
user="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' deploy-postgres-1 | sed '/^$/d')"
pin="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-pin"
test -f "$pin/group2373696859_thread4640.json" || exit 67
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$pin" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
compose="$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml"
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
previous="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")"
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$img")"
if test "$previous" = "$expected";then echo CURRENT_RUNTIME_ALREADY_MATCHES=PASS;else
  docker image tag "$previous" create-videobot:menu-pre-redraw
  armed=1
  rollback(){ docker image tag create-videobot:menu-pre-redraw create-videobot:local-poll; docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo RESTORE_PREVIOUS_IMAGE_ATTEMPTED; }
  trap 'if test "$armed" = 1;then rollback;fi' EXIT
  docker image tag "$img" create-videobot:local-poll
  docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$compose" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null || exit 69
  sleep 7
  test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 70
  test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$n")" = "$expected" || exit 71
  docker exec "$n" grep -q 'A plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 72
  docker logs --tail 600 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 73
  docker logs --tail 600 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || exit 74
  test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || exit 75
  armed=0
fi
echo LIVE_MENU_CODE_AND_IMAGE_ID=PASS
echo LIVE_DM_POLL_AND_GATE=PASS
